bio.text: Ginny Ehrhart represents Georgia House District 36, which includes portions of western Cobb County, and was sworn in on January 14, 2019.
Ehrhart is the daughter of a U.S. Army lieutenant colonel, has lived in Cobb County for more than 45 years, and graduated from Auburn University with a degree in international trade.
Ehrhart taught high school economics and American government, owned a small business, worked as a television chef and wrote two cookbooks, and lives in Powder Springs.
